note: Public msn contact-card registry feed for micyte.com. Datum-derived from the MOS registrar via network_map_viewer, with entity_kind read from the flat `registry` card doc (the four network kinds) and status derived from the contract records — micyte.com's own copy (no FND coupling). status: live=has a non-refused contract (or the operator), still=curated profile not yet contracted, listed=directory. ENTITIES ONLY: event rows (farm stands, farmers markets, CSA pickups) are excluded — a farm stand is an event of an entity, never an msn node; events ship as event records in the MSS offering instead.
